title: Human peripheral B cells: a different cytometric point of view.
abstract: Human peripheral B lymphocytes, analyzed by current flow cytometers, frequently show complex patterns of morphological and fluorescence signals. However, fluorescence intensity values are commonly reported without any correlation to the cell surface area. We propose a different approach, based on the evaluation of the ratio of phenotype fluorescence intensity to forward scatter intensity, to determine the apparent fluorescence density of surface molecules.
journal: Cytometry. Part A : the journal of the International Society for Analytical Cytology
